newsitem.title: USA: Thinking Tools names Whalen CEO.
newsitem.headline: Thinking Tools names Whalen CEO.

text.p: Thinking Tools Inc said Tuesday it had named Phillip Whalen Jr as president and chief executive officer.
Thinking Tools was formed as the Business Simulations division of Maxis Inc. It was spun off from Maxis in 1993 and priced its IPO on October 24.
The company produces and sells software that allows users to simulate real-life business situations, explore operational problems and improve decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Whalen was most recently vice president of Digital Tools Inc's European operation.
